verdict.rationale: Phaser's core product is an MIT-licensed JavaScript framework. Users install it locally via npm (or the template CLI), bundle it and serve it from their own infrastructure, and games built with it are not tied to a licence, so the framework itself is self-hostable. Missing for 10: explicit first-party self-hosting or deployment documentation, and self-hostable options for the hosted Game Agent and MCP tooling (the probe says the official MCP rides the hosted Game Agent).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: the app will download and configure the right package for you
any games you created will still work — they are not linked to the licence.
